extracted.name: Dill Vinaigrette
extracted.description: Red wine vinegar, dill, onion and garlic powder, and mustard blend to make this simple to prepare vinaigrette.
instruction_lines: In a blender, combine the oil, vinegar, sugar, dill weed, salt, onion powder, garlic powder, dry mustard and pepper. Blend until smooth, cover and refrigerate until chilled.
